1879073389.name: Low Cut
1879073389.desc: A low cut in front of you which briefly slows the movement speed of multiple enemies.

conditionalEffects.description: No focus loss on movement for a short duration after using Low Cut.
Melee Skills have a chance to generate additional Focus for each enemy hit.
Low cut applies or tiers up Lingering Wound.
Low Cut now applies a 3s Root.

1879107949.name: Smouldering Wrath
1879107949.desc:
A channelled skill dealing huge amounts of fire damage every second. This skill cannot be interrupted.

Duration increases per battle attunement.

This skill consumes 1 attunement per second.

Requires Battle Attunement.

1879113581.name: Valiant Strike
1879113581.desc: A melee attack that heals the Morale of nearby allies.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879139053.name: Scratch and Snip
1879139053.desc: You attack with claws and fangs.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879166829.name: Passage of Nature
1879166829.desc: Allows you to track the presence of nearby beasts and other natural creatures.

1879173357.name: Sable Harvestmath Horse
1879173357.desc: A horse from the Fall Festival.

1879198317.name: Friend of Sturdy Beasts (Black Bear)
1879198317.desc: Summons a bear companion.\n\nBears are tough companions which can draw the ire of the enemy.

1879201261.name: Improved Devour
1879201261.desc: Your hatchling sacrifices itself to provide you with sustenance.  This skills is only usable in combat.

1879233005.name: Javelin and Fist
1879233005.desc: Capable Wardens prepare their javelin and fist for attack.

1879240813.name: a mounted melee attack
1879240813.desc: You auto-attack when dual-wielding one-handed weapons.

1879244909.name: Improved Scribe's Spark
1879244909.desc: A basic lightning rune deals lightning damage and builds battle attunement.\n\nDecreases threat.

1879248365.name: Seeking Arrow - Light
1879248365.desc: Steadying your mount, you attempt a well-placed shot at an enemy that will deal Light-based damage and apply a potentially harmful effect to your target.

1879250029.name: Clash of Arms
1879250029.desc: Using superior tactics, you deal very little damage to a target but assess the enemy so well that you gain a significant advantage over your foe.

1879270509.name: Barrage of Fire
1879270509.desc: A quick attack that deals more damage each time it is used.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879272557.name: Drink from the Boot
1879272557.desc: A time-honoured tradition.  Drink from the boot!  Live a little!

1879274093.name: Snap Shot - Shield Piercer
1879274093.desc: Special javelins will pierce a defender's shield and bend, making the javelin difficult to remove and  the shield nearly useless.

1879275757.name: Fleetness
1879275757.desc: You feel as though you could dance through the battlefield.

1879309805.name: Steed of Spring Gardens
1879309805.desc: A horse from the Spring Festival.

1879315053.name: Tan-back Cave-claw
1879315053.desc: Summons a tan-back cave-claw to help you search for riches!

1879315181.name: Takedown
1879315181.desc: Knocks an enemy down for a short duration.

procEffects.description: Evading an attack applies an Incoming Healing bonus to you. This can only trigger once every 12 seconds.

1879316845.name: Execute
1879316845.desc: Consume remaining Wrath to deal a massive amount of damage. Places a mitigation buff on the fellowship.

1879319277.name: Bear-form
1879319277.desc: Beornings can assume the form of a bear in the midst of combat.

1879352173.name: Rescued Steed of Agarnaith
1879352173.desc: Rescued from the cruelty of Lhaereth.

1879377645.name: Grey Mountains Expedition Goat
1879377645.desc: A goat belonging to the Grey Mountains Expedition.

1879396205.name: Steed of the Morgul Victor
1879396205.desc: This steed bears trophies from your hardest fought victories in Minas Morgul.

1879400045.name: Winter Celebration Pig
1879400045.desc: Brings out a friendly pig pulling a cart of goodies for any celebration.

1879409773.name: Grey Pig
1879409773.desc: A happy pig who would like to see the world with you.

1879418605.name: Cozy Tabby Cat
1879418605.desc: Summons a cuddly tabby cat to keep you company.

1879428077.name: Take a Breath
1879428077.desc: Care for yourself and your comrades. Places a heal over time on the Brawler and increases incoming healing for the fellowship.

1879449837.name: Bee Swarm (Dual)
1879449837.desc: Call forth a swarm of bees to attack your foe.

conditionalEffects.description: Bee Swarm's Damage Over Time will now affect the enemies around the target.
In addition to damage, Bee Swarm also applies:  *

1879458541.name: Courageous Heart
1879458541.desc: Improves your defences for a brief time.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879463021.name: Black Bull
1879463021.desc: Summons a black bull to accompany you on your journeys.

1879467245.name: Pitch Pot
1879467245.desc: A pot filled with boiling pitch. Creates a patch of burning ground that damages enemies and degrades their armour.

conditionalEffects.description: Haversack skills may reduce your target's Outgoing and Incoming Damage.

1879469805.name: Draining Strike
1879469805.desc:
Your prowess is unmatched, and your skill with the blade literally drains the Power from your foe.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay Finisher:
 Enables Re-centre.</rgb>
<rgb=#ecdd11> Improves the Enervating Counter effect if present.</rgb>

1879470573.name: Re-steady (mounted)
1879470573.desc: Re-steady yourself, restoring morale and power after using a finisher skill.

1879488365.name: Gust of Wind
1879488365.desc: Tearing winds cause frost damage in a small radius.\n\n<rgb=#ff0091>When traited in Nature's Fury, this skill has a chance to make Burning Embers burn hotter and spread to nearby foes.</rgb>

1879491565.name: Wizard's Fire
1879491565.desc: A basic sigil which burns your foe over a brief time and restores your Power.

conditionalEffects.description: Wild Sigils:\nWizards Sigils will encourage your pets, tiering up different buffs for each element.\n

After using a Lightning Skill, your Frost Skills will slow enemies.

After using a Fire Skill, your Frost Skills will make enemies Brittle, increasing their incoming Critical Chance.
Wizard's Fire burns enemies around your target.

1879495149.name: Pitched Bird Call
1879495149.desc: Play a high pitched bird call.

1879497709.name: Minor Pet Command
1879497709.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.

1879506541.name: Shadow Sheath
1879506541.desc: Bathe yourself in shadows, shielding you from the enemy.

1879509357.name: Share The Fun
1879509357.desc: Share Stealth with one ally while remaining within 5m of one another.

1879516781.name: Drop Yellow Mushroom
1879516781.desc: Drop your current mushroom.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>The mushroom will explode when dropped.</rgb>

1879521261.name: Humming Sunbird
1879521261.desc: Summons a humming sunbird to accompany you on your travels.
